Sign on display reads: The vessel sponge fishery is prosecuted from small boats carrying two men...While the boat is sculled and managed by one man, the other, called the "hooker," watches the bottom through a glass-bottomed bucket - the water glass - which is held with one hand, while with the other he manipulates a long pole to which is attached a three-pronged hook...

The Lewis and Clark Exposition was hosted by the city of Portland from June 1 to October 15, 1905. Covering over 400 acres, the fair showcased exhibits from various nations and states, and it promoted the economic potential of the Pacific Northwest region.
